challengeDescription: Take a team selfie outside a traditional pub on Old Kent Road.
Find an item for sale in a local market for exactly £1.
Pose like an angel next to a prominent street sign.
Take a photo of the team looking at the departure boards inside Euston station.
Count how many steps it takes to walk the steepest part of Pentonville Road.
Record a video of the team doing their best synchronized Royal Wave.
Take a stern photo outside a government building.
Get a photo mimicking the pose of the lions at Nelson's Column.
Act out a famous 10-second movie scene outside a major cinema.
Find the most expensive looking item in a shop window and pretend to buy it.
Safely cross a busy intersection using a designated pedestrian crossing.
Spot and photograph a luxury car parked along Park Lane.
Have the whole team strike their most sophisticated, wealthy pose.
Take a creative photo referencing Harry Potter somewhere near the station.
